scope: Indianapolis and Central Indiana local-history, civic-context, community, organizational, and place-based research resources

records.name: Encyclopedia of Indianapolis
records.description: An expanding digital reference resource presented by The Indianapolis Public Library covering Indianapolis people, places, events, organizations, topics, timelines, exhibits, guides, and Central Indiana atlas information.
records.availability_notes: Use this resource for local context, organizational history, neighborhood and place research, civic background, and discovery of Indianapolis institutions. Entries may provide historical or descriptive context rather than current eligibility, service availability, or application instructions; verify time-sensitive operational details with the organization itself.
